title: Verify: preload.test.ts BootScene planner and fallback unit tests
summary: Add BootScene cases with phaser and content mocked
description: Extend game/tests/preload.test.ts with a BootScene block mirroring the mocking pattern in game/frontend/tests/bootScenePreload.test.ts (the BootScene.preload and resolveKey contract in game/frontend/src/phaser/BootScene.ts).
acceptance_criteria: Only the known referenced asset is loaded
Fallback key used for unknown or failed ids
technical_constraints: vi.mock('phaser'), vi.mock of '../frontend/src/runtime/content' and '../frontend/src/store/gameStore' if needed

steps.lines: top of file, before imports of BootScene
steps.action: Add vi.mock('phaser') returning default { Scene: class { events = { once: vi.fn() } }, Scenes: { Events: { SHUTDOWN: 'shutdown' } } } and vi.mock('../frontend/src/runtime/content') returning a scene with objects asset 'objects/bed' and 'objects/ghost' and a manifest declaring only 'objects/bed' (path 'worlds/the-boys-room/furniture/bed.svg', type 'image'). Import BootScene from '../frontend/src/phaser/BootScene'.
steps.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/preload.test.ts -t 'BootScene'
steps.expected: BootScene imports under node env without real Phaser

steps.symbol: new: describe('BootScene uses planner and fallback')
steps.action: Build a BootScene, stub boot.load = { image: vi.fn(), on: vi.fn() } and boot.make = { graphics } returning a chainable fake with generateTexture and destroy as vi.fn(); spy console.warn. Call preload() and assert image called once with ('objects/bed','assets/worlds/the-boys-room/furniture/bed.svg'), warn called with 'unknown asset ref: objects/ghost', generateTexture called with ('fallback:missing',8,8). Assert resolveKey('objects/ghost') and resolveKey('nope') equal 'fallback:missing' and resolveKey('objects/bed') equals 'objects/bed'.
steps.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/preload.test.ts
